## Adding Slides or Materials

To add slides, an app, or other materials, contact Bryan McComb ([asadahshuidswg@gmail.com](mailto:asadahshuidswg@gmail.com)) or Courtney Henry ([asadahshuidswg@gmail.com](mailto:asadahshuidswg@gmail.com)) with the file and confirmation of permission to share. See the [README](https://github.com) for technical instructions on uploading files to the `files/` folder.
